[RFCS.11.6] An **inspecting** reader that does not use `RuleFireAnnotation`
MUST skip it.  The `rule_name` field on each fact-bearing atom
remains sufficient for fact-level provenance without `RuleFireAnnotation`.

**A replaying reader must not skip it.** `RuleFireAnnotation` is compare class
([RFCS.3.1]) and is one of the two atoms the byte-compare is performed over
([LFST.9.3.7]); a replayer that skipped it would drop half the comparison and
still report success. The permission above is for a reader that compares
nothing ([RFCS.1.2]).
